title: Limiting spectral distribution for the adjacency matrix of the Watts-Strogatz random graph
summary: The Watts-Strogatz random graph model on $n$ vertices with parameters $K$ (a positive even integer) and $p \in [0, 1]$ is constructed in two steps. First, one starts with a ring lattice on $n$ vertices, where each vertex is connected to its $K/2$ nearest neighbors on each side. Each edge in turn is then independently rewired with probability $p$ by replacing one endpoint with a uniformly chosen vertex not already adjacent to it.
